correctness.summary: The exact area formula is monotone in the relaxed band count, giving a unique exact balance. Direct Taylor expansion verifies the balance-point series, the unique cancellation of the linear-regime n^-2 bias, the quartic real-relaxation term, and the cubic integer-rounding term.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The classical exact area formula and m/n^2 convergence criterion are excluded from the novelty claim. No located source states the finite-n balance threshold, the unique bias-cancelling linear aspect ratio, or the associated quartic and integer-cubic asymptotics; residual folklore risk remains because the derivation is elementary.

value.summary: The result supplies an exact under/over-estimation boundary and a tunable high-accuracy regime for a canonical counterexample in surface approximation, including a practical O(F^-3/2) integer-mesh area rate.

limitations: Only the standard staggered Schwarz lantern on a circular cylinder is treated.
Only total lateral area is optimized.
The exact balance point is a real relaxation; integer meshes require rounding.
Originality is to the best of our knowledge; equivalent folklore may exist.
